label: AdRoll
terms_note: Register as a developer and create an application (consumer key + secret); authenticate with OAuth 2.0 or a Personal Access Token from the dashboard settings page (token + application client ID); base URL https://services.adroll.com; default quota 100 API requests per service per day (raise on request); NextRoll API Terms of Service. Free.

discovery.auth: oauth2 or Personal Access Token (+ apikey / client id query parameter)

reference.verdict: **Verdict** — has_api: **yes** (NextRoll API for AdRoll: CRUD, GraphQL Reporting, Audience, Universal / Automated / Prospecting
auth: 1. Create a developer account, then an application (one for production, one for testing) → consumer key + secret.

2. Either OAuth 2.0 (authorization code with the app's redirect URI — "Get Started with OAuth 2.0") or a **Personal Access Token** created in the dashboard settings, sent together with the application's client ID; API keys are also supported (`apikey` always in the query string — "Migrating to API K
3. First call: fetch the Advertisable EID (the advertiser account) — most calls are scoped by `advertisable`.

fields.name: token
fields.help: AdRoll Personal Access Token (dashboard > settings > Personal Access Tokens), sent as `Authorization: Token <PAT>` (https://apidocs.nextroll.com/guides/get-started.html).

fields.name: client_id
fields.help: Client ID (consumer key) of your NextRoll developer application, sent in the `apikey` query parameter on every call.

me.note: GET /api/v1/organization/get: the caller's organization {eid, name, created_date}. Default quota is 100 requests per service per day.

list_accounts.note: GET /api/v1/organization/get_advertisables: the organization's advertisables (the ad accounts); `id` is the advertisable EID used as account_id.

list_campaigns.note: GET /api/v1/advertisable/get_campaigns?advertisable={account_id} (is_active defaults to true, so only active campaigns are listed; `status` filters `statuses`). `budget` is the WEEKLY budget (raw.ui_budget_daily says whether the UI shows it as daily). No paging.

get_report.note: GET /api/v1/report/campaign?data_format=entity: per-campaign totals over the range (USD by default). Prospecting and new-style Facebook campaigns are not in this endpoint (NextRoll recommends its GraphQL Reporting API for those).

pause_resume.note: PUT /api/v1/campaign/pause or /api/v1/campaign/unpause ?campaign={campaign_id}; `status` is the campaign status after the change. Resuming restarts spending.

not_offered.update_budget: "POST /api/v1/campaign/edit … budget: The new WEEKLY budget for the campaign" (with ui_budget_daily required); AdRoll stores weekly budgets and the adapter cannot convert a daily amount (https://apidocs.nextroll.com/crud-api/reference.html).
